title: Error
description: The core's normal shape. 404: unknown workspace (errors.workspace) or entitlement key (errors.key, listing the valid keys). 422: validation, by field. 400: missing Idempotency-Key. 401: no or wrong token ({"message": "Unauthenticated."} only). With PM_INTERNAL_API_TOKEN unset, every path is a 404.
